title: renderApplication
summary: Render the optional Preact application document and hydration snapshot.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: Pass request, the server routes, the root module and the deployed browser entry URL.

sections.title: Returns
sections.body: Returns a Promise<Response> containing the complete HTML document or a redirect/resource response.

sections.title: Usage
sections.body: Render the optional Preact application document and hydration snapshot.

sections.title: Page actions and hydration
sections.body: For a page POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE, the server runs the action once before loading the page data. JSON action results become snapshot.actionData, so useActionData reads the same result during server rendering and after hydration. A data(value, { status, headers }) result preserves its status and response headers in the HTML response, including validation statuses and cookies. Returned action errors populate snapshot.error for the route boundary. Redirects and non-JSON HTTP responses are returned directly without rendering a document.

sections.title: Behavior and limits
sections.body: Requires preact-render-to-string. Each request creates and disposes its own router. Use the Express guide for HTTP hosting; this API buffers the document.
